title: Seeing Beyond the Natural to the Heavenly Point of View
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner takes us on a journey through the Bible, exploring the importance of having a heavenly point of view in our daily lives. Drawing from the story of Elisha and the King of Israel in 2 Kings chapter 6, Pastor Chris Zehner shows us how to navigate life's challenges with faith, trust, and spiritual vision. Join us as we discover the transformative power of a heavenly perspective and learn how to see God's plan unfolding in our lives.
